title: SRE prioritization checklist + follow-ups (weekly prep)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for weekly ops sync (channel + 1:1 follow ups). This is a scratchpad — mix of agenda, metrics, and items to assign post-meeting.

Top-level agenda (30m):
1) Quick health snapshot (5m) — SLOs, error spikes, paging trend headline
2) Incidents review (10m) — 2-3 highest impact items and short mitigation recap
3) Prioritization (10m) — what to escalate to product/infra this week
4) Action review + owners (5m)

Health snapshot (notes to self):
- Overall request success SLO (p50/p95) last 7d: p50 latency 45ms, p95 latency 220ms (target p95 < 200ms).
- Error-rate SLO: 0.6% request errors (target < 0.5%). Trending up after Tuesday deploy.
- Paging frequency: paging per week = 9 (avg last month = 4). Spike on Tue/Thu from autoscaler loop noise.
- Top affected region: eu-west-1 (3x higher retries).
- Cost-impacting alerts: two noisy debug logs causing ingestion backpressure on monitor pipeline.

Paging trend quick analysis (what to say in sync):
- Root cause hypothesis: aggressive autoscaler cooldown/oscillation combined with a metrics aggregation lag -> transient throttles.
- Evidence: multiple pages tied to scale-up errors in autoscaler logs, timestamps align with metric ingestion backlog.
- Mitigation so far: rolled back autoscaler version v2.7 -> v2.6 on Tue 02:30 UTC (reduced pages by ~60%).
- Next ask: infra to add jitter to scale-down path + add metric smoothing.

Top incidents to call out (brief):
- INC-2026-17: autoscaler regression -> regional timeout -> failed to allocate reserved-capacity pods (customer impact minor, 7 customers throttled). Priority: P1 (Mitigated). Postmortem owner: Samir.
- INC-2026-21: embedding-store GC pauses -> transient 5-10s tail latency for embeddings (affects batch embed jobs only). Priority: P2. Action: GC tune + bump instance type. Owner: Jordan.
- Ongoing: intermittent tokenization errors from model-loader (low volume) — creating ticket JIRA-SRE-482 to track.

Prioritization candidates (ranked):
A) Autoscaler fix (short-term): jitter + inhale cooldown + add synthetic load test to CI. Estimated effort: 2 engineers, 1 week. Rationale: reduces pages and p95 latency.
B) Metric pipeline hardening (medium): add buffering for metrics ingestion, increase retention for rollups to 120s. Effort: infra + observability, 2-3 weeks.
C) Embedding-store GC improvements (short): GC tuning + small instance bump for stable business hours. Effort: 1 week.
D) Prompt/Model routing fallback policies (low): create fallback to smaller quantized model when latency > 400ms. Effort: product+serving-runtime, MVP 3 weeks.

Meeting asks (what I need from people during sync):
- From infra: commit to autoscaler jitter change and target date. (ask Samir to confirm rollout window)
- From observability: add dashboard panel for ingestion-lag histogram and a synthetic autoscaler load test. (ask Jordan to own)
- From runtime: collect traces for model-loader failures and attach to JIRA-SRE-482. (ask Annie if available)

Action items (post-sync follow-ups):
- [ ] Samir: create PR for autoscaler jitter + smoke test plan. Due 2026-04-06.
- [ ] Jordan: start GC tuning experiment on staging, log baseline and new tail latencies. Due 2026-04-07.
- [ ] Me (Maya): draft short incident blameless postmortem outline for INC-2026-17, include timeline and customer impact, assign reviewers. Due 2026-04-05.
- [ ] Observability (TBD): add ingestion-lag panel and set 95th percentile alert at 30s. Due 2026-04-09.
- [ ] Product: decide if fallback routing is acceptable for Canary customers. Slack /product for a quick sync. Target decision by 2026-04-14.

Notes to self / things to say in sync:
- Keep message short: "we mitigated but need systemic fixes — autoscaler + metrics ingestion".
- Emphasize customer impact numbers (7 customers, minutes lost) not internal log counts.
- Ask for temporary guardrails: throttle debug log rate to prevent pipeline backpressure.

Unresolved questions (call out):
- Why did autoscaler v2.7 get past canary? (need release-engineering to confirm canary coverage)
- Is embedding-store GC regression from recent JVM update or config drift? (require heap dumps from staging)

Backlog tickets to consider for deprioritization this sprint:
- SRE-90 (infra-cost-analysis for dedicated) -> move to next sprint unless infra team bandwidth frees up.
- SRE-103 (prometheus rule cleanup) -> low customer-facing impact, postpone.

Quick checklist before sync (my prep):
- [x] confirm numbers from SLO dashboard (p50/p95/error-rate)
- [x] pull incident timelines for INC-2026-17 and INC-2026-21
- [ ] ping product for fallback routing decision maker
- [x] prepare one slide for on-call timeline (two bullets)

Post-meeting follow-ups (what I will do immediately):
- Post short summary in #sre-ops channel with action item list and owners.
- Open postmortem skeleton in Confluence and link INC-2026-17.
- Schedule infra sync for autoscaler jitter rollout (30m).

Random notes / brain dump:
- Consider adding a weekly "noisy-alerts" review to reduce paging — 15m slot after ops sync to triage.
- Consider recording synthetic load test results weekly and attach to release notes for autoscaler changes.

End of scratchpad. Will tidy for final notes and publish to shared drive if needed.
